_comment: Expansion 3 part F.1: allies on the field - Find Familiar and Find Steed (docs/expansions/03-demigods-magics.md), numbers from the 2024 Player's Handbook. Done in game/allies.py (road ops 'familiar' and 'steed'); in a fight the 'ally' op calls Battle.add_ally. The steed's three once-a-day gifts are spells of the steed alone (classes 'creature': no scroll, no spellbook).

find_familiar.name: Find Familiar

material.text: burning incense worth 10+ GP, which the spell consumes

find_familiar.text: A spirit serves you as a small beast (bat, cat, owl, raven...), celestial, fey or fiend at heart. It goes where you go, keeps watch at night and Helps in every fight, but cannot attack. At 0 hit points it is gone until cast again; it can be sent away and called back.

find_steed.name: Find Steed
find_steed.text: A steed from another world (a horse, camel or dire wolf to look at; celestial, fey or fiend) fights beside you and carries you on the road: AC 10 + level, 5 + 10 hit points a level, a slam of 1d8 + level. It vanishes at 0 hit points or when you die.

steed_fell_glare.name: Fell Glare
steed_fell_glare.text: A fiendish steed's glare (once a long rest): a Wisdom save or Frightened until the end of its rider's next turn.

steed_fey_step.name: Fey Step
steed_fey_step.text: A fey steed steps through the world to a free place up to 60 feet away (once a long rest).

steed_healing_touch.name: Healing Touch
steed_healing_touch.text: A celestial steed's touch heals a friend beside it 2d8 and the spell's level (once a long rest).
